summary: Diff adds substantial frontend wiring for Question Gallery management (new QuestionEditorDialog, ExternalBlob utilities, and updates to QuestionManagementPanel/useQueries). Backend/main.mo shows type additions for gallery questions and blob fields, but the diff summary is too truncated to confirm required backend CRUD endpoints, stable storage upgrade hooks, or delete behavior updates.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend Question Gallery CRUD APIs (create/list-by-subject/update/delete) with admin-only enforcement for mutations, authenticated read/list, unique ids, and delete removal from TestConfig.questions arrays.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and does not show any public methods implementing create/list/update/delete, any admin checks/traps, or the specific deleteQuestion behavior that also removes questionId from TestConfig.questions.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persistent stable storage for gallery questions and counters (survive upgrades without id collisions; safe preupgrade/postupgrade).
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the diff summary of stable variables or system preupgrade/postupgrade logic to serialize/restore question gallery state and nextQuestionId.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend workflow/API to upload image blobs and return Storage.ExternalBlob refs; create/update accepts optional question/option images; list-by-subject returns ExternalBlob refs.
missing_requirements.reason: Although types include ?Storage.ExternalBlob fields and frontend uses ExternalBlob helpers, the diff summary does not show backend API methods enabling blob upload/attachment or ensuring list-by-subject returns stored blob references.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified multiple unrelated UI pages/components and styling (e.g., Header/Footer redesign, Landing/About/Dashboard changes, placeholder TestInterface/ResultPage, MathJax global setup, Tailwind theme extensions).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest scope is limited to Question Gallery CRUD + persistence + Admin UI wiring; these changes are not requested and are outside the stated non-goals/constraints.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin panel routing/view logic updates and additional admin panels beyond Question Gallery (e.g., Suggestion moderation).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks to wire Question Gallery UI and add create/edit support; other admin features are not requested here.
